text: Out the door, down the street, into the fog.
Behind me, footsteps. Hundreds of them. All in step.
The only light in town was the lighthouse.
Inside, there were gears. Thousands of them, turning.
The baker's. The mailman's. My teacher's.
And one empty space. With my name on it.
You found my secret, said a voice.
He was very old. And he was the only one who didn't smile.
Long ago, everyone left this town. I was all alone, he said.
So I built a new town. And I taught them all to smile.
But I could never teach them to feel. Except for one.
I looked down at my chest.
There was a tiny golden key. Ticking.
I was his first. His favorite. The only one who could cry.
In this town, everyone smiles... except us.
